description: This file contains implementation of big number (BIGNUM) exponentiation functions, including modular exponentiation used in cryptographic operations, with licensing information and internal helper functions.

methods.name: int BN_mod_exp_simple(BIGNUM * r,const BIGNUM * a,const BIGNUM * p,const BIGNUM * m,BN_CTX * ctx)
